notes.title: Achievements update!
notes.notes:
Happy to announce our first update!
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/61746565/cyrillic.jpg[/img]

Changelog:
[list]
[*] added Cyrillic characters as achievements
[*] achievements system rebalanced, many of them can be found in first chapters now 
[*] levels with achievements are now visible on map, when overlapping specific level button with mouse
[*] [b]B[/b] - turns on/off background animations
[*] [b]S[/b] - turns on/off windowed mode
[/list]
